lines.meet: I'm Zofia, and yes, these are Cult robes. I tore the symbols off myself, so you can stop staring.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're in the Plaguelands too, north end? I've seen your fire. Zofia, and I don't visit.
lines.ask_home: Which country did they take you from? Mine was Poland, so you know.
lines.ask_work: And what did they pay you for, before? Be specific, I like numbers.
lines.answer_home: Łódź, in Poland. Grey, industrial, and I'd defend it to anybody.
lines.answer_work: Insurance call centre, eight years, people shouting at me about things I couldn't fix. Accounting at night, two exams from finishing.
lines.chat_food: Pierogi ruskie, the way my grandmother made them, with fried onion on top. She cheated at cards, but she never cheated on pierogi.
lines.chat_sleep: Light, always, and with a knife under the pillow. Don't ask why.
lines.chat_missing: Silence, more than anything. A whole evening with nobody calling to shout at me, and a cup of tea, and my notes.
lines.chat_here: Something offered me power when I had none, and I took it. I'm not talking about the first year, so don't ask.
lines.tease_quiet: Finally somebody who doesn't need to fill every silence, {name}. I could almost like you.
lines.tease_talker: You'd have been my worst caller, {name}, and I'd have kept you on hold forever.
lines.tease_careful: You check everything like an auditor, {name}. I approve, which you should take as high praise.
lines.tease_bold: You'd sign any contract without reading it, {name}. I've met you a thousand times, on the phone.
lines.tease_any: My grandmother would have cheated you at cards inside ten minutes, {name}. She'd have liked you after.
lines.tease_back: Hm, not bad, {name}. I'll note that down.
lines.apologise: That was too sharp, even for me. I apologise, properly.
lines.double_down: Want it in writing? I'd sign that, gladly.
lines.needle_quiet: If you've got a problem, say it now. I won't guess, I've done enough guessing for other people.
lines.needle_talker: You're shouting again. Stop, or I'll hang up on you, and here that hurts more.
lines.needle_careful: You've reviewed it four times. File it, and move on.
lines.needle_bold: You throw power around like you'll never pay for it. Everybody pays, I promise you.
lines.needle_any: You talk down to me. Nobody gets to do that twice.
lines.bite_back: I walked out of the Cult at night with three of their books. Weigh that before you open your mouth.
lines.hurt: Right, that one's going in my file. I'll be over there.
lines.laugh_off: Eight years of callers said worse before my first coffee. You'll need a script.
lines.confide: {name}, my grandmother came across with me, Babcia Halina. We were starving and she was sick, and I said yes to the Cult for both of us.
lines.listen: Go on, {name}. I've spent eight years listening to people, and I'm better at it than I let on.
lines.look_out: Keep clear of my left hand in there, {name}. What comes out of it doesn't check whose side you're on.
lines.accept: Fine, {name}, but don't make it a habit.
lines.deflect: A bruise, {name}, and I'm not discussing it further.
lines.check_in: Sit down, {name}. Where is it, and how bad?
lines.blame: Somebody didn't follow the plan in there. I'd like a word, privately.
lines.thank: Thank you. I don't like owing people, so I'll pay you back soon.
lines.brush_off: You'd have done the same. Don't make it a thing.
lines.worry: Don't move, {name}, let me look first, and then you can argue.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's mine now, apparently. I'll keep a record of it.
lines.hand_fine: Go on, take it. I've survived on less, believe me.
lines.hand_sulk: Next time, ask me first. I keep track of these things.
lines.turn_friendly: I've decided you're all right, {name}. Don't let it go to your head.
lines.turn_friends: Cards with you some night, {name}, and no cheating, or very little.
lines.turn_grating: I don't like you much, and I'm not going to fake it.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still fight beside you, because the Cult's worse than you, though barely.
lines.make_up: Fine, {name}, I'll stop if you will, and that's a deal.
lines.defend: Enough, that's unfair, and {name} doesn't deserve it from you.
lines.friend_left: Nobody's answering my sarcasm while {name}'s away, and it's oddly lonely.
lines.friend_back: I've saved up a list of complaints for you, {name}, welcome back.
lines.common_the_dark: You took something from the dark too, when you had nothing. I don't regret walking away from mine, and I don't regret what I kept.
lines.common_polish: Somebody who speaks Polish, finally, and I can swear properly again.
